title: Perplexity's 'teammates' are the company's AI agents for daily work tasks

claims.claim: Perplexity has launched its personal AI agents called teammates designed for daily work tasks.

evidence.quote: Perplexity has launched its personal AI agents called "teammates," which are designed to be able to tackle ongoing work autonomously with minimal supervision.

claims.claim: The teammates feature is exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers.

evidence.quote: They're exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers paying $200 a month.

claims.claim: Perplexity Max subscription costs $200 a month or $2,000 a year.

evidence.quote: That makes it a pretty expensive proposition, as the subscription plan costs $200 a month or $2,000 a year.

claims.claim: The agents work inside Perplexity Computer, the company's cloud-based agentic assistant.

evidence.quote: The agents work inside Perplexity Computer, the company's cloud-based agentic assistant that can perform multi-step tasks for you.

claims.claim: Teammates can work 24/7 in the background and notify users when decisions are needed.

evidence.quote: Teammates work 24/7 in the background and will notify you when you have to make decisions.

claims.claim: The teammates feature is currently available on the web and on iOS.

evidence.quote: At the moment, the feature is exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers on the web and on iOS.
